Title: EVT-OP-028: Mixed-type stationary Brown–Resnick processes
Labels: open-problem, area:processes, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** OPEN-EXPLICIT in 2009–10; current status unverified. The survey rates it out of reach.

## Source and quote
Wang and Stoev, Adv. Appl. Probab. 42 (2010), arXiv:0903.3594, §7:

> The question raised in Kabluchko [ 15 ] on whether there exist stationary Brown–Resnick processes $X$ of mixed type i.e. with non–trivial dissipative and conservative components still remains open.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
It decides whether every stationary Brown–Resnick process has a mixed moving maxima representation. Practical relevance is low.

## What the library already has
Max-stable processes via Poisson random measures (`IsPoissonRandomMeasure.isSimpleMaxStable_map_process`).

## What is missing
Gaussian path integrals and the ergodic decomposition. Brown–Resnick is not formalized.

`docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS_SURVEY2.md`, D7. Survey feasibility estimates are unchecked plans, not results.
